description: The board library: an array of board profiles bundled with or imported into the app.

builtin.description: True for a profile bundled with the app; imported profiles are coerced to false.

clonedFrom.description: Id of the board this profile was cloned from.

components.description: Components on the board that need a cutout, opening or label.

cutoutMargin.description: Extra clearance around the cutout in millimetres; omit for none.

cutoutShape.description: Cutout outline: a rounded rectangle or a circle; omit for the kind default.

facing.description: Face the component sits on; omit for a top-side component.

fixtureId.description: Id of a bench fixture that documents how this component is held while probing.

id.description: Unique id for this component within the board.

kind.description: What the component is; this chooses the cutout profile and how the picker draws it.

position.description: Component origin on the board, in millimetres: X/Y from the PCB corner, Z above the board top.

z.description: Z in millimetres; Z is up, with the board top at Z 0.

size.description: Component extents in millimetres, before any cutout margin is added.

z.description: Z in millimetres; Z is up, with the board top at Z 0.

text.description: Silkscreen legend drawn on the board, for components of kind "text-label".

crossReference.description: URL of an alternate source that corroborates the dimensions.

datasheetRevision.description: Revision of the datasheet the dimensions were read from.

defaultStandoffHeight.description: Gap in millimetres between the cavity floor and the underside of the PCB.

enclosure.description: A finished device in a vendor shell, for the stand archetype; omit for a bare PCB.

body.description: The vendor shell body in plan view and depth, in millimetres.

bossDiameter.description: Diameter in millimetres of the shell mounting bosses.

bossHeight.description: Height in millimetres of the shell mounting bosses.

edgeProtrusions.description: Bumps on the shell face that a mount must channel around; omit for none.

depth.description: How far the protrusion stands out in millimetres.

edge.description: Body face the protrusion is on.

from.description: Start of the protrusion along that edge, in millimetres.

to.description: End of the protrusion along that edge, in millimetres.

flangeThickness.description: Thickness of the device shell wall in millimetres.

sliderChannel.description: Rear T-slot channel a slide-on bracket locks into; omit for none.

cavityWidth.description: Width in millimetres of the wide part of the T-slot.

length.description: Length in millimetres of the channel along the body.

lipDepth.description: Depth in millimetres of the retaining lip; must be less than totalDepth.

throatWidth.description: Width in millimetres of the narrow slot opening; must be less than cavityWidth.

topFromDeviceBottom.description: Channel top position in millimetres above the bottom of the device.

totalDepth.description: Total depth in millimetres of the channel.

id.description: Stable id for the board, e.g. "esp32-devkit-v1"; the library keys off this.

measurementMethod.description: How the dimensions were obtained: datasheet, open-source CAD, or a physical measurement.

mountingHoles.description: Mounting holes that should receive standoff bosses; may be empty.

diameter.description: Hole diameter in millimetres; the standoff boss and screw pass through this.

id.description: Unique id for this hole within the board.

x.description: Hole centre X, millimetres from the board origin at the PCB corner.

y.description: Hole centre Y, millimetres from the board origin at the PCB corner.

name.description: Human-readable board name shown in the picker.

pcb.description: The bare PCB: its size determines the case cavity footprint.

size.description: PCB extents in millimetres; Z is the board thickness.

z.description: Z in millimetres; Z is up, with the board top at Z 0.

recommendedZClearance.description: Clearance in millimetres to leave above the tallest component.

retentionClips.description: Explicit board-retention clips; omit to let the builder choose placements.

edge.description: PCB edge the clip is placed on.

offset.description: Distance in millimetres from the start of that edge.

reach.description: How far in millimetres the clip reaches over the board; omit for the default.

style.description: A two-jaw clip or a shelf-only support tab; omit for "clip".

width.description: Clip width along the edge in millimetres; omit for the builder default.

retentionFootprint.description: Restrict board retention to this rectangle of the PCB; omit for the whole board.

x.description: Footprint origin X in millimetres from the PCB corner.

y.description: Footprint origin Y in millimetres from the PCB corner.

retentionShoulder.description: Raise a perimeter seat rim so a face-down board sits snug; omit for off.

schemaVersion.description: Board-profile format version; omit for version 1.

secondaryBoardMounts.description: Boards held above the floor on snap clips; omit for none.

clips.description: Snap clips that hold the secondary board.

edge.description: Board edge the snap clip is placed on.

offset.description: Distance in millimetres from the start of that edge.

width.description: Clip width along the edge in millimetres.

id.description: Unique id for this secondary mount.

overhang.description: How far in millimetres the board may overhang its supports.

position.description: Where the secondary board sits in plan view, in millimetres.

z.description: Z in millimetres; Z is up, with the board top at Z 0.

standoffHeight.description: Height in millimetres above the cavity floor.

source.description: URL the board dimensions were taken from; required for built-in profiles.

version.description: Publisher version of this profile ("1.2.0" or a counter); bump when the data changes.

visualAssets.description: Optional model and photo assets, with the licence and source they were taken from.

glb.description: Path or URL of a glTF binary (GLB) model.

license.description: Licence that permits redistributing the assets; required with any asset.

sideImage.description: Path or URL of a side-on board photo.

sourceUrl.description: Where the assets came from; required with any asset.

topImage.description: Path or URL of a top-down board photo.
